away.summary: The Maple Leafs (9-14-3) are projected to start Anthony Stolarz in net. Kirill Marchenko and Colton Sissons are expected to return to the lineup after extended absences due to lower-body injuries. The team is dealing with four injured forwards and defensemen, while Cole McWard, Zack MacEwen, and Dakota Mermis are listed as scratched.

home.summary: The Boston Bruins (15-8-1) will start Jeremy Swayman in goal, as confirmed in prior coverage. Charlie McAvoy is healthy and available after recovering from a facial injury sustained in November. James Hagens remains out with a back injury and has missed seven straight games, though he practiced in a non-contact jersey this week.
